# B1+Trainer

> A free, ad-free Goethe-B1 **Redemittel** (functional-phrase) trainer for German writing and speaking. Given an English translation, the learner reconstructs the correct German sentence from a word bank or fills cloze blanks. Content spans levels B1–C2.

B1+Trainer is operated by Digi.S — Digital Sprache Stiftung. The user interface is in German; this file is written in English for clarity. The app is free to use under a pay-what-you-want model. Mobile-first, no accounts required.

## Practice
- [Practice picker](/): choose a skill (Schreiben/writing or Sprechen/speaking), filter by level, and pick a function card to start. Each card opens the exercise player at `/uebung/[lessonId]`, where you rebuild German sentences from a shuffled word bank or fill cloze blanks (keyboard 1–9 / Enter / Backspace).

## Reference
- [Redemittel reference](/lernen): a searchable list of every phrase with its English translation, grouped by exam part, function, and level.

## Exam
- [Writing exam simulator](/pruefen): Goethe-B1 writing tasks graded by AI against the four official criteria (Erfüllung, Kohärenz, Wortschatz, Strukturen), with A–E bands and a 60% pass threshold.

## Support
- [Pay what you want](/pay): a voluntary payment to cover hosting, database, and AI-grading costs. Not a charitable donation.
